item.description: The Context class lacks proper implementation of asynchronous trigger methods. Current implementation returns None placeholders which causes AttributeError and TypeError failures in testbenches that rely on these features.
item.contract: Implement proper Context methods for signal triggering and sampling: 1. `posedge(signal)` - returns a trigger for positive edges 2. `negedge(signal)` - returns a trigger for negative edges 3. `changed(signal)` - returns a trigger for signal value changes 4. `sample(signal)` - samples signal value with proper return handling 5. `tick(domain)` - advances simulation by clock cycle 6. `delay(interval)` - delays execution by specified interval 7. Proper integration with simulation state for getting/setting signal values
item.acceptance: Tests that fail due to: - AttributeError: 'Delay' object has no attribute 'delay' (test_sim.py::SimulatorRegressionTestCase::test_abandon_delay) - TypeError: Context.changed() takes 2 positional arguments but 3 were given (test_sim.py::SimulatorRegressionTestCase::test_latch) - AttributeError: 'NoneType' object has no attribute 'negedge' (test_sim.py::SimulatorRegressionTestCase::test_edge) - TypeError: 'async for' requires an object with __aiter__ method, got NoneType (test_sim.py::SimulatorRegressionTestCase::test_struct) - AttributeError: 'Tick' object has no attribute 'sample' (test_sim.py::SimulatorRegressionTestCase::test_sample) - AttributeError: 'Tick' object has no attribute 'repeat' (test_sim.py::SimulatorRegressionTestCase::test_critical)

item.description: The PyCoroProcess constructor incorrectly handles testbench functions. It's not properly detecting when a testbench function expects a context parameter and is not passing it correctly.
item.contract: Fix testbench detection and context passing in PyCoroProcess: 1. Properly detect when a process function is a testbench (takes ctx parameter) 2. Pass Context object to testbench functions when they expect it 3. Ensure testbench functions can access simulation state via the Context object

item.description: The Simulator.add_testbench method is not properly implemented. It doesn't distinguish between regular processes and testbench processes, and doesn't handle the context correctly.
item.contract: Implement proper testbench process handling: 1. Distinguish between testbench functions (expecting ctx parameter) and regular processes 2. Add special handling for testbench functions that receive a Context parameter 3. Ensure testbench processes can properly interact with the simulation state
